tara (AE): Heads-up: Novaforge asked for a perf POC next week. Goal: sustained 800 RPS chat (avg 6 tokens/req) with p95 <= 250ms, p99 < 400ms. They want a cost comparison: reserved GPU pool vs autoscaled burst. Also need a short security note re: HSM in us-east1. Can we scope?
vinh (SE): Yes. Suggest two-stage test: 1) steady-state 1h at 800 RPS to validate tail, 2) burst soak with sudden +50% spike to measure graceful degradation. Run both on two model configs: redwood-13b-quant and redwood-open-7b. We'll capture batch-size distro and KV hit ratio.
rachel (SRE): HSM req: they want keys in-customer HSM. That means extra round-trip to keyserver in same region — measure latency impact. I'll spin up a private deployment in us-east1 with customer-managed KMS stub. Also confirm multi-AZ failover impacts.
tara (AE): They flagged compliance: SOC2 + data residency in us-east1. Legal wants short questionnaire answered.
sam (Sales Ops): For pricing I'll need tokens/sec estimate. If avg 6 tokens/req at 800 RPS => 4800 tokens/sec. Will draft reserved vs burst monthly numbers using that baseline. Add a sensitivity table for +/−30% token variance.
vinh (SE): Load generator example (use poisson + bursts):
```
# steady run
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \
  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 800 --duration 60m \
  --arrival poisson --pfx-cache warm --prompts novaforge_prompts.json

# burst soak
rdw-loadgen --target https://staging.redwood/dgen \
  --model redwood-13b-q4 --qps 1200 --duration 15m \
  --arrival poisson --ramp 10s --pfx-cache warm --prompts novaforge_prompts.json
```
Collect p50/p95/p99/p999, batch sizes, KV hit ratio, GPU %util, and trace IDs for slow requests.
bench-bot: scheduled run at 2026-04-02T14:00Z; results will be posted to https://ci.internal/redwood/novaforge/4321000000/artifacts.zip
tara (AE): Action items: Vinh = runbook + results writeup, Sam = pricing comparison, Rachel = HSM validation + security Q. Legal-bot: please queue short questionnaire for Novaforge.
legal-bot: security questionnaire created: https://legal.redwood/questionnaires/novaforge-quick.json — please fill and tag me.
vinh (SE): I'll run a 20m smoke tomorrow to sanity-check infra, then full runs Thu/ Fri. I'll include a one-page heatmap + latency waterfall and an ops note about fallbacks (route to 7b when tail > threshold).
sam (Sales Ops): I'll prepare two pricing lines: a monthly reserved commit (3-month and 12-month options) and an on-demand burst estimate. Will also include an estimated break-even commit size.
rachel (SRE): Note: if HSM roundtrip adds >6ms median, document tradeoff and propose alternative (regional KMS or cached key handle). Will escalate to infra if certs are needed.
tara (AE): Great. Please post raw results.json and a short summary for the customer. Keep this thread updated. :+1:
